summary: One ZAP finding was reported: a missing anti-clickjacking header on 5 URLs of the app running on localhost. The diff was empty, so there is no code to check the cause against. No instructions were found in the PR data.

items.message: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header on 5 URL(s), for example http://localhost:3000
items.title: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
items.explanation: Responses from the app do not send X-Frame-Options or a CSP frame-ancestors directive. An attacker could load a page inside an invisible iframe on a malicious site and trick users into clicking buttons, such as confirm or delete actions, without realizing it (clickjacking). The risk is highest on pages with state-changing actions for logged-in users. The scan hit a local dev server, and the diff is empty, so the real exposure depends on what is deployed.
items.fix: Add the header globally in the server or middleware, for example Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' (or 'self' if you need same-site framing). Optionally also send X-Frame-Options: DENY for older browsers. In Express, helmet() sets both. Then rerun ZAP to confirm.
